string.ContactSupportDescription: Send an email to our support team
string.MobileNotSupported: Sorry, mobile devices support coming soon. In the meantime, please use Desktop
string.AccessDenied: Object doesn't exist or you are not permitted to access it.
string.WorkspaceIsArchived: Workspace is archived because of being unused, Please contact us to restore...
string.WorkspaceIsMigrating: Workspace is being updated. Please wait...
string.OnboardingInviteTeamDescription: A workspace is your team's shared place for tasks, chats and documents. Send colleagues an invite link to bring them in.
string.OnboardingTargetUnavailable: This button is not available to you here, or it is hidden in the current view.
string.OnboardingAppearanceDescription: The gear in the top right corner switches between light and dark theme and changes the interface language.
string.OnboardingSearchDescription: The magnifier in the top right corner, or Ctrl+K (Cmd+K on Mac), finds tasks, documents, people and platform commands.
string.OnboardingInviteStep1: Click your avatar in the bottom left corner
string.OnboardingAppearanceStep1: Click the gear in the top right corner
string.OnboardingAppearanceStep2: Choose the theme and the language
string.OnboardingHelpCenterDescription: Documentation, settings, keyboard shortcuts and support are gathered in the Help Center. You can also take this tour again there.
string.SelectToOpenHint: Pick a section or a space in the navigation panel on the left.
string.OnboardingSearchStep1: Click the magnifier in the top right corner
string.OnboardingSearchStep2: Type what you need: an issue, a document, a person or a command
string.OnboardingFinishedText: Everything else is in the documentation. You can take the tour again from the Help Center: profile menu, "Help & Support".
string.OnboardingChooseCategory: Pick a section to see its steps.
string.OnboardingCancelledText: You can take it again from the Help Center: profile menu, "Help & Support".
